title: The manifest declares the project's environment set once and enforces it thereafter
iWant: the working agent to elicit our environment names once and record them in the manifest
soThat: the environment shape is legible on-disk and boot resolution is unambiguous

acceptanceCriteria.description: The manifest carries a top-level `environments` array whose values are the operator-elicited environment names; every entry's `paths` object has exactly the same key set as `environments`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a manifest with `environments: ['dev', 'ci', 'live']` and an entry whose `paths` omits `ci`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the manifest loader validates the file
acceptanceCriteria.then: the loader rejects the manifest with a stable-coded `SECRETS_ENV_PATH_MISSING` error naming the entry and the missing environment string

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Secrets Manager client selects exactly one environment at boot from an unambiguous input; two ambiguous inputs (a set variable and a flag both provided with conflicting values) fails boot.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a boot with the environment variable resolving to `dev` and a `--env live` flag also provided
acceptanceCriteria.then: boot fails with a stable-coded `SECRETS_ENV_AMBIGUOUS` error naming both inputs, and no vendor call is made

acceptanceCriteria.description: A required secret whose per-environment path is set to null or an empty string for the active environment fails boot.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a manifest entry `X` with `required: true` and `paths.live` set to null, resolving in the `live` environment
acceptanceCriteria.then: boot fails with `SECRETS_REQUIRED_ABSENT` naming `X` and `live`, and no listener binds to any port
